items.caption: Root-cause analysis from a real failed run: navigation, cookies, and price extraction all worked — the actual miss was a page-type mismatch (marketplace listing vs. individual vendor page), not bot detection.
Published success rates by configuration, straight from the README — an honest operational range instead of a single "it works" claim.
The typed record every scrape produces — business name, starting price, structured packages, and a success flag with an error message when a run comes back incomplete.
Container health check — reports unhealthy if the package fails to import, catching broken dependency state before a scheduled run starts.
